- Episode Title: "VIRAL: Who Removed Charlie's Wedding Photo, And Why?"
- Source Used for Analysis: Transcript (cleaned) with video context references
- Transcript Completeness Status: Complete (chaptered, cleaned, captions-derived)
- Artifact Families Introduced: A-1772, A-1773, A-1774, A-1775, A-1776, A-1777, A-1778, A-1779
- Existing Nodes Reused: N-1 (Charlie Kirk), N-2 (Erika Kirk), N-3 (Candace Owens)

This episode is built around an artifact-anchored discrepancy: a wedding photo visibly present in the background of Charlie Kirk's home studio during his September 8, 2025 broadcast is missing from the same background during Erika Kirk's December 12, 2025 Glenn Beck interview conducted from that office. Candace Owens walks through possible explanations (Kolvet moved it, Erika moved it, Charlie moved it on Sept 9, deliberate staging), ultimately positing that Charlie himself removed the photo on September 9, 2025 – which she ties to other allegedly suspicious activity that night (sleep swap, wedding ring removal, priest visit).

The second major evidentiary block concerns Carrie Prejean Boller's removal from the White House Religious Liberty Commission. Artifacts include the hearing clip and Dan Patrick's removal announcement on X. The third block presents informant testimony about the TPUSA All-American Halftime Show's production (pre-filmed, 180 audience, multiple takes, $250 stipends, Erika not present), with a counter-artifact photograph of Trump watching the Bad Bunny halftime show at Mar-a-Lago.

The episode functions structurally as both a fact-update on the Wedding Photo discrepancy and an expansion of the September 9, 2025 night-before timeline investigation. It also serves as a tangential political commentary segment on the Religious Liberty Commission and a credibility assessment of TPUSA's post-assassination public-facing events.

lines: - **Name uncertainty (Carrie Prejean):** Transcript variants include "Carrie Prejean Boller" (00:57, 26:59), "Carrie Peen" (00:57), "Carrie Prejean Boller" (34:48), and "Carrie Preaching Baller" (as preserved in Dan Patrick's own X post text). Inscribed as "Carrie Prejean Boller" pending verification of canonical spelling. The actual surname appears to be "Boller"; transcription noise preserved as-is.

- **Name uncertainty (Andrew Kolvet):** Transcript spells "Andrew Kolvet." The TPUSA spokesperson is generally known as Andrew Kolvet. Not used as a node here since no artifact anchor is presented for him in this episode; preserved as host commentary only.

- **Name uncertainty (Stacy Sheridan):** Appears only in host speculation ("In fact, it would be much more likely that Stacy Sheridan would have added that picture"). Preserved as host rhetoric; not inscribed as claim.

- **Name uncertainty (Carrie Prejean Boller):** Dan Patrick's own quoted text on X reads "Carrie Preaching Baller," which is itself a likely transcription/OCR artifact rather than the actual name. Flagged for verification.

- **Artifact verbally referenced but not shown in full:** A-1774.2 (Glenn Beck segment on phone denial) and A-1775.1 (Fox News segment on wedding ring) are played in part but the full interview is not shown; characterization is therefore limited to the portions that aired.
- **Possible transcription error:** "Bassam Yousef" referenced in viewer comment at 46:33 – preserved as it appears.

- **Requires human verification:** All informant-based claims (C-6570, C-6575, C-6573, C-6571) rest on Candace Owens' secondhand reporting from unidentified informants present at the TPUSA halftime filming. Source identity, number of informants, and corroboration status are not disclosed in this episode.

- **Claim failed admission test (not inscribed):** The host's claim that "Charlie messaged multiple people saying that he thought they were going to kill him the night before" is referenced but the underlying messages are not displayed or quoted in this episode; not inscribed as a C-claim despite being thematically central. Anchor for this claim would have to come from a prior or future episode.

- **Claim failed admission test (not inscribed):** Candace Owens' assertion that "a priest came over to pray over Charlie and Erika's marriage the night before is what I am told" is presented as hearsay ("is what I am told") without an artifact anchor in this episode; not inscribed.

- **Claim failed admission test (not inscribed):** Candace Owens' speculation that "Charlie and Erika were arguing that night" over Israel pivot is interpretive commentary drawing on the artifacts but not directly supported by any artifact in this episode; not inscribed.

- **Claim failed admission test (not inscribed):** Candace Owens' claim that Tyler Robinson's case has produced no evidence tying him to the assassination is interpretive commentary; not inscribed as a C-claim, but tracked as investigation target N-10508.
